title: GootHub
features:
About this script
🎨 Menu System
FeatureDescriptionToggle keyRightShift — opens/closes the menuDraggableClick and drag the title bar to move the menuClose / MinimizeButtons in the top-right cornerAuto mouse unlockWhen menu opens — cursor is freed. When closed — cursor is locked back to centerInventory-awareIf the game's inventory UI is open, the cursor stays unlockedSidebar tabsLeft column with 4 categoriesSub-tabsHorizontal row inside each categoryCompact modeReduces element height for denser layout

👁 Visual Tab
ESP (Player Visuals)

FunctionDescriptionBoxDraws a 2D rectangle around each playerFilled BoxSame as Box, but with semi-transparent fill (color picker available)NameShows the player's username above the boxDistanceShows distance in meters next to the nameHealthColored health bar on the left side of the box (green → yellow → red)SkeletonDraws bones from head to feet (R15 and R6 supported)Active WeaponShows the currently equipped tool name below the box

Indicators

FunctionDescriptionTracersLine from the bottom-center of the screen to each playerHead DotSmall circle over each player's headOff-screen ArrowArrow pointing toward players outside your view

NPC

FunctionDescriptionNPC Name TagBillboard above each NPC showing Name | NPCNPC HighlightFull-body outline highlight (uses Highlight instance)

Inventory

FunctionDescriptionInventory CheckerRenders the inspected player's inventory on your screenInventory KeybindKey to hold for showing the inventory (default: F)Show Full InventoryRenders all item stacks in a 9×6 gridShow Inventory ValueEstimates total ruble value from Price attributesCheck CorpsesAlso inspects corpses (not just living players)

Misc

FunctionDescriptionExit ESPMarks all extraction/exit zones with a billboard + distanceQuest Item ESPMarks quest items in QuestItems folderCorpse ESPMarks bodies in DroppedItems folderContainer ESPMarks crates, safes, boxes with a whitelist checkBoss InformationFloating panel showing Anton / Dozer / Whisper / Death HPBoss Info MovableAllows dragging the Boss Info panelCheater DetectorFlags suspicious players (high KDR, HSR, fresh accounts) with red [Cheater] tag on ESPMod DetectorFlags players with premium/admin level ≥4 or invisible limbs — orange [Moderator] tag

🎯 Combat Tab
Aim

FunctionDescriptionAimbotMain aim assist toggleModeLock (moves camera) or Silent (only rotates ViewModel)Aim KeybindKey or mouse button that activates aimbot (default: Q, or right-click)Target PlayersInclude players as valid targetsTarget AIInclude NPCs from AiZones as valid targetsWall CheckOnly aim at visible targets (raycast)Team CheckSkip players in the same clan as youPredictionLead moving targets based on muzzle velocityAuto ShootAutomatically presses mouse1 when a target is lockedSticky AimKeep aiming at the same target instead of switchingAim PartWhich bone to aim at (Head, UpperTorso, etc.)SmoothnessCamera lerp speed (1 = instant, 20 = slow)Silent Y OffsetAdjust aim height in silent modeShow FOV CircleRenders a circle showing the aim FOV radiusFOV RadiusRadius in pixelsFOV ColorCircle color when no targetFOV Target ColorCircle color when a target is lockedFOV Dynamic ColorAutomatically switch between the two colorsFOV ThicknessCircle outline widthFOV Transparency %0 = opaque, 100 = invisible
